title: Now Follows the Episode of Kullu

blocks.text: As efforts are made on his behalf, Banda refuses any rescue that would diminish his own honor or the Guru’s, and instead resolves to free himself by wonder rather than compromise.
The cage rises into the sky under the force of summoned aid, turning imprisonment into spectacle and terror for the Kullu ruler and his people.
The flying cage is the defining image: it reverses captivity into marvel and carries Banda’s authority back out over the hills.
